balls.text: holes out in the end, slices that fullish delivery straight to deep extra cover where Bravo takes a simple chance
two more, pitched on a length, lofts it over extra cover, didn't time it all too well, a couple more
tries to swing that past midwicket, got an inside edge onto the show for a single
shortish outside off and he smacks it in front of extra cover into the deep for a couple of runs
swing and a miss again, got across to swing it over midwicket, again made no contact
short of a length and Karthik misses out, made room to cut that past point, didn't make contact
poor ball, full toss on the off, makes room and clatters that over extra cover, almost carried for six, middled it superbly
fullish on middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a well-run couple again

dropped, Ashwin was the man at short fine, tried to scoop that one too but didn't get it as high as he wanted, Ashwin was the man at short fine, stretched his right hand to snap that, got his hand to it but it didn't stick, AB gets the desired result, it rolls over the ropes for a boundary
goes across to scoop that one over short fine for a couple of runs
that's disappeared, picked the slower one and gave it a good whack, smashed it from the crease over the deep midwicket boundary, brings up his half-century
aiming for the yorker, was outside off, squeezed past extra cover into the deep for a couple of runs
slower one on the off, drags that over midwicket into the deep for a couple of runs

Rampaul goes, dismissed by his team-mate, outside off and he chases that one, gets a thick edge and Dhoni dives low to his left to complete a sharp catch, Bravo celebrates in typical Bravo style, a jig on the middle of the pitch
angling in towards middle and it's been pushed back to the bowler
wide again, has to reach out to play that one, too wide outside off stump
wide, has to reach for that one, tries to square-drive that past point, doesn't get his bat to it
gets forward and tries to open the face again, this is slightly wider, misses
beaten, short of a good length and gets that one to nip away, just went past the outside edge as he tried to open the face
slower one on a good length, flicked through midwicket into the deep for a single
Christian, who replaced Henriques for this match, goes, short and he pulls it straight to midwicket, was intending to go over that man but ended up doling out a simple catch
on a good length, pushes that one through extra cover for a couple of runs
edged and gone, short and wide and Kohli charged out to cut that over point, the shot was well and truly one, ended up getting a thick edge to Dhoni
slower legcutter, on leg and middle, pushes it gently through midwicket and they have enough time to run back for the second
length again but straight to the fielder this time, driven superbly but straight to Hussey at extra cover
length ball and it's punished, in the slot on the off and Kohli picks that up to deposit it over the wide long-on boundary
slower one bowled round the wicket on middle, flicked through midwicket for a single to bring up his half-century, a fluent one but also fortuitous, was caught-behind earlier in his innings
slower one on leg stump, tickled, uppishly, through square leg for a well-run couple, Kohli is made to work hard for the second as Hussey sends out a powerful throw, hits Kohli's bat
down the leg side, almost a full toss, Kohli got no bat on that one, a wide
drives that one down to long-on for a single
dropped, Bravo tried to snap that one with his left hand, Kohli mistimed it back towards him and Bravo reacted in time but couldn't hold on in his follow through
on a good length outside off, tries to swing it past midwicket, mistimes it to long-on for a single
banged in short outside leg stump, tries to help that on its way fine, misses, called a wide
on the pads and it's flicked past square leg into the deep for a couple of runs
banged in short on middle and Kohli pulls that over midwicket for a couple of runs
slower one bowled short, the freehit doesn't cost much, AB made room there and tried to smack it over midwicket, mistimed it just for a single
banged in short on middle, freehit coming, he overstepped there, they pick a single as he drops that in front of point
Hussey doesn't age, full toss outside off and he squeezes that past extra cover, Hussey runs across from deep extra cover and dives full length to his right to drag that back in
some width there and he mistimes it, gets a thick inside edge back to the bowler
this one has been smashed in front of square, banged in short on middle and he bludgeons it past midwicket
slower one and AB picks the length early to swing it behind square leg, there is a fine leg in place but he's got no chance there
AB tries to reverse-paddle past short third, gets an outside edge this time, a leading edge, past extra cover for a single
easy pickings for AB, slower one from Bravo, turns out to be a full toss, was the attempted legcutter, just helps it past the diving square leg
slower one outside off, tries to open the face there, gets an inside edge in the direction of short fine for a single
moved well across, outside off, and was looking to turn it past midwicket, struck on the pads, they get a leg-bye, don't know what Bravo was appealing for there
on a length on the off, makes room and slices that towards deep point for a couple of runs
Superb from AB, took it from the off stump, moved well across and paddled it past short fine for a boundary
long hop, it's pulled away towards deep square leg, AB will again feel he missed out, just the single
attempting the reverse-paddle, doesn't connect it well enough, wanted the single but Kohli decided against it
the carrom ball, punched past extra cover for a single
flat and full on leg stump, that's just nudged past midwicket and these two are swift between the wickets, AB calls for the second and makes it in time
flicked away through square leg into the deep for a couple more runs
Kohli sends that into the second tier, tossed up, he charged out and hammered it hard over the long-on boundary
pushes that one down the ground to long-on for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, pushed straight to point

that's gone, there was a sound! Oh, the umpire shakes his head, short of a good lenght and Kohli was looking to open the face, there was a noise as the ball went past the outside edge, and Dhoni went up immediately, replays show there was contact, with the bottom of the glove, the umpire doesn't think so. AK Chowdhary was the umpire, Kohli's been given a reprieve
an offcutter on the off, pushed gently between extra cover and point for a single
pitched on a length and that's been drilled down the ground to long-on for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, knocks it past point, third man takes a while to get to it, a couple of runs
fullish on leg stump, drives it through midwicket into the deep for a single, that makes Kohli the highest run-getter this IPL
fired down the leg side and AB will feel he missed out there, swept it straight down to deep backward square leg for a single
slowed it up and held it back, comes down the track and punches it to long-off for a single
drives it on the front foot towards midwicket, AB was backing up there, Raina aimed at the non-striker's end and missed
slightly short on middle, flicked away through square leg for a single
lovely wristwork by Kohli, charged out to whip that from the off stump but struck it on the bounce to deep midwicket
shortish on middle, pulled away and finds the gap, struck it hard to beat deep midwicket who tried to cut that off running to his left but failed
flatter on middle, gets forward and turns it past square leg for a single
flighted on the off, pushed through past extra cover for one more
fullish outside off and Kohli eases that through point and cover for a single
makes room does AB and chips it past extra cover for a single
A wristspinner's action and he's been smashed, turns out to be a full toss outside off and AB thwacks him over extra cover
flighted from Ashwin, worked away but straight to midwicket

A leg-side stumping, Dhoni was smooth on that, flat delivery bowled outside leg, Agarwal charged out and then had to change direction but failed to make contact, Dhoni collected and took out the bails, wide signalled but Chennai won't mind that
flatter this time, punched towards long-off for a single to raise the Bangalore fifty
pushed it full on middle, drives it towards long-on for a single
gets on the back foot and turns it wide of short fine for one more
appeared to come off the back of the hand and turned in, the offspinner, chopped past point for a single
slightly short outside off, cut away past point into the deep for a couple of runs
slightly short, punches it towards extra cover from the crease
flatter and quicker on middle, pulls it away towards deep midwicket for a single
Agarwal clears long-on, charges out to that flighted delivery and launches it high and long over long-on
that turned and it was played smartly by Kohli who waited for it and guided it past short third for a single
slipped it flat on middle, gets a thick inside edge as he tries to play that through cover, past midwicket for a single
goes on straight, punches that through extra cover into the deep for a single, tidy start for Ashwin
turns it away through midwicket into the deep for a single
flatter and straight on middle, flicked away towards square leg from the crease, can't beat the in-field
slowed it up this time, gets forward and just defends it in front of the bowler
flatter on the off, takes it from the off and turns it away to midwicket
floating in towards middle, gets across and drives it to midwicket
pitched on a length, pushes it uppishly through the line to mid-off for a quick single
Punished, short on the off and Kohli pulls it away disdainfully over midwicket for a one-bounce four
drops that one in front of point, wants the single but is sent back by Agarwal
shortish on middle, looks to pull it square, gets a thick inside edge as he tries to do that, just a single to deep square leg
back of a length outside off, guides it down to third man for  a single
Sharma bowls that slightly short on middle and Kohli punches that down the ground to mid-on
ooh, that lands just short of extra cover, slower one dragged short and Agarwal checks his shot as he punches at that one, was uppish but is lucky it didn't carry
angling in towards middle, gets front and across and pushes it back to the bowler

easy pickings for Kohli, turns it off the hips past short fine into the deep, Badrinath runs across from deep square leg and pulls the ball back in, diving over the ropes as he's doing it, saves a run
width and Kohli cashes in, opens up and flays that over the in-field on the off side for a one bounce four
back of a length outside off, cuts that towards third man for a single
back of a length on middle, knocks it down in front of midwicket for a single
smartly done, bowled at 129.6 kmph according to the IPL speedometer, opened the face at just the last moment to late-cut it past the keeper for a boundary
shortish outside off, another single to third man, easily guided down
angling in towards middle, gets across and drives it towards mid-on
slightly short on middle, rocks on the back foot and works it in the direction of midwicket
slightly short on middle, rocks on the back foot and punches it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle, gets on the back foot and turns it into the leg side
hits a good length, opens the face a little and guides that one down to third man for a single
back of a length outside off, cuts it through point and cover, was in full control of that one, boundary
goodish length on middle, gets on the back foot and knocks it down into the off side
slightly short outside off, runs it towards point from the crease
short and wide and he reaches to cut that past point, misses
edged and short, short of a good length, moved away, got a thick edge short of first slip, tried to open the face there
pushed it full outside off, digs it out towards point
Gayle's gone, big blow, made room to that good length ball and had to reach for it as it was pitched outside off, stretched, got a thick edge straight to Dhoni
on the stumps this time, pushed back towards the bowler
short of a good length, almost dragged it back on, gets an inside edge as he tries to tap it into the off side, didn't miss the stumps by much
pitched on a length outside off, he leaves that one alone to the keeper
angling in towards middle, that's defended wide of extra cover for a single
low full toss, the extra delivery costs him, struck sweetly past mid-on for a boundary, Gayle's away, struck off the meat
down the leg side and it's called a wide, Gayle tries to clip that fine but can't make contact
banged in short on middle and Gayle sways out of the way in time
nice delivery, pitched up outside off, moving away from a length, he leaves that alone to the keeper
back of a length on middle, rocks on the back foot and defends it in front of the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg, strikes him on the thigh again as he tries to work it into the leg side
slightly short on leg stump, strikes him high on the pads as he tries to work it square

gone! RCB have snatched victory! Oh no, they haven't! RP has bowled a no-ball! Chennai have won, that was short and wide and Jadeja edged it straight to third man as he tried to cut that. But the umpire Chowdhary has called it a no-ball, RP overstepped according to the umpire. RP overstepped by a big margin there, definitely a no-ball, they get a run for the overstepping and another one for the single they snatched as the catch was taken
on a length, drives it hard down the ground to long-on for a single
full on leg stump, drives it down wide of long-in, Kohli doesn't pick it up cleanly, two more, 3 off 2 now
slower one outside off, cut towards point for a single, he's off strike, just the single
Jadeja, you beauty! This is down to the wire, another length ball from RP and he launches that clean over long-on for six
third man is up and Jadeja scores a boundary first ball though a touch fortutiously, big outside edge as he tries to go over long-on, four past short third
Morris flicks that past square leg for a couple to keep strike
a couple, comes down the track and cracks that through extra cover into the deep for two more runs, KL Rahul, the substitute, has done a good job so far

appeal for lbw and he's been given! Moved well across to drive that through midwicket, was struck on the pads, struck him in line there, didn't look like he inside edged it, Rampaul has taken another one, that would have hit off and middle
two more, that was in the air for a while and it seemed it would carry the distance, full outside off and he lofts that over extra cover for a couple
I called it too early when I said Dhoni's was the decisive breakthrough, you still need to get past this man, short and Bravo latches on, pulling it clean over deep midwicket for six
down the leg side, short ball down leg and Rauf calls it
Dhoni is gone, the decisive breakthrough you would think, length ball outside off and Dhoni tried to drive that hard into the off side, got a thick edge to the keeper
Vinay finishes the over well, full outside off and that was dug out wide of point for just the single
angling in towards middle and leg, slower one, pushes it towards long-on for a single
pitched up outside off, a couple more in front of deep point for Chennai
slower one bowled on middle, turned away past midwicket into the deep for a couple more runs
mid-off is inside the circle and he manages to find the boundary, pitched up and he lofts it over the in-field, Kohli isn't happy with Vinay
back of a length, chops that towards third man for a single
wide ball, just past that marker on the off side, called by the umpire
Jadeja goes for the pull and misses, sharp bouncer and was a touch too quick for the batsman who tried to smack it square
pitched up on the off, drives it towards long-off for a single
misses, dot ball, goodish length outside off and he was looking to slash it past point, didn't make contact
two more, flayed it through the off side, length ball and Rampaul will be relieved it's just a couple, Christian fields it in the deep, then fumbles
that's disappeared, on the ROOF! Picked it up from outside off and demolished it over the wide long-on boundary, someone had to fetch it from the roof there

ooh, superb attempt in the deep by Rahul, short and it's flat-batted by Dhoni who smacks it hard wide of long-off, to the fielder's left, Rahul dives full length and reaches out with his left hand, can't hold on, an excellent effort
length, Jadeja tried to drive that through off, got a thick outside edge, third man is up and he has no chance there, a much-needed four for Chennai
well fielded in the deep again, short and he makes room to crack that in front of square, the substitute fielder cuts it off to keep them to two again

short and wide, that's been cut down past point, Mayank Agarwal runs across and drags it back in diving to his right, he has saved the boundary but has hurt his little finger on the right hand, was in a lot of pain was Agarwal, he's stepped off the field
bowled it full on middle, gets deep into the crease and flicks it towards square leg, was eyeing that gap between square leg and short fine, couldn't bisect it
short of a length outside off, reaches to play that one, misses
pitched up and that's been struck past the bowler towards long-on, Kohli takes a while to get to it and Dhoni completes the second
drives it down towards long-off and guess what, Kohli misfields in the deep to concede another run, two to Chennai
slower one outside off, guides it wide of point in the direction of third man, Jadeja scampers back for the second
looks to cut, it is the slower one close to the body and he misses
full and wide, he squeezes it out to the sweeper for one, and that is all he is getting
Dhoni's blasted this overpitched delivery straight to Gayle at extra cover on the edge of the circle
stays beside the line and steers a length ball coming in from round the stumps, to point
low full toss and he just concedes a single, to long-on
on the pads, nudges it through square leg for a single, freehit coming after RP oversteps, overstepped by a long way there
straight on middle and leg, flicks it through square leg into the deep for a single
low full toss on the off, smacks it towards long-on for a single
Dhoni explodes, length on the off and he picks it up superbly, launches it high and far into the stands behind deep midwicket
goodish length, gets forward and knocks it wide of point for a single
short of a good length on the off, punches it to long-off for a single
shortish on middle, punched through midwicket for a single, no second on offer there
lucky to get away with that one, Dhoni was looking to help it fine, down the leg side, called a wide
flatter from Syed there and Dhoni, who charged out, had to adjust and ended up playing it back to the bowler
tossed up on leg stump, drives that through midwicket into the deep for one more
slightly short on middle, works it through midwicket into the deep for a single
hits that into the deep with the turn, made room and lofted it but didn't connect well, Agarwal ran in from deep cover and dived forward to judge it superbly, second wicket for Syed Mohammed
shortish outside off, cuts it towards point from the crease
tossed up on the off, drives it down to long-off for a single
Badri comes down the track and smacks him hard over the bowler's head, long-on runs to his left to stop that, dives full length but can't cut it off
tossed up, lofts it over extra cover for a couple of runs, long-off runs to his left and keeps them to two, AB was the man there
turns it into the leg side in the direction of square leg for a single
taps it wide of extra cover for one more
tossed up on the off, drives it wide of extra cover off the front foot for a single
shortish on the off, crunches it straight to extra cover from the crease
gets across to that straight delivery and turns it past square leg for a single
floating it on the off, eased through to deep cover for a single
Raina goes, big blow, that's a short one bowled quick on the off, Raina was looking to clear midwicket, got a top edge there and gifted a catch to Kartik at short third
comes down the track and chips it towards long-on for a single
Raina made room to cut that one towards deep point for a single
Raina gently tucks it around the corner for a single
flighted on middle, drives it down towards long-on for a single
floating it on the off, square-drives that one past point for two more runs
punches that through midwicket for a well-run couple
chops that one behind point, no single on offer there
shortish outside off and he finds the gap, nicely placed by Badri, short of a length and he cuts it between point and short third
gets across to turn it fine, gets a leg-bye
crunches it down to long-off for a single
shortish on the off, punched towards long-on for one more run
shortish on middle, gets on the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler
slower through the air, short on the off, punched towards long-off for a single
Raina paddle-sweeps that really fine, bowled round the wicket on middle and Raina found the gap superbly
slightly short on middle, pulled past midwicket into the deep, two more as it's cut off in the deep
flighted, Badri comes down the track and strikes it over Kartik's head for a boundary, easily done, Kartik isn't happy that long-on and long-off are too wide
floating it wide of the off stump, steers that wide of point for a single
flicks that one through midwicket into the deep for a single
flatter on middle, swung away towards deep midwicket for a single
floating it on leg stump, tries to sweep it fine, Badri wants the single, Christian throws to the non-striker's end, just makes it back
beaten, got it to move away off the pitch, Badri stretched forward to push that through the off side, missed
drops that short and Badri finds the gap this time, pulls it well through square leg, a big gap in the deep and it fetches him four
back of a length on the off, pushes that one wide of extra cover for a single
banged in short outside off, pulled towards deep midwicket for a single
on a good length, makes a bit of room and opens the face to play it towards point
shortish on middle, Badri gets on the back foot and jabs it towards midwicket
back of a length, rolls his wrists to play it towards short fine, no run on offer there
mid-off is a little wide, on a good length and Raina just drives that superbly through the line past mid-off
on the pads and Raina dismisses it, picking it superbly past short fine, much squarer than short fine for four more
dropped, should have been taken at third man, short outside off and Badrinath guided that into RP Singh's hands but RP, who is in a good position to take it, spills it
slightly short on middle, gets back and turns it through square leg for a single
slower one but that's nicely struck, pitched on a length and Raina drove it well, hard past the non-striker for a boundary
gets across to tap that in front of midwicket for a single
straighter on middle, gets a little across and plays it towards midwicket
lovely hit, through the line, width from Christian and he leans forward to loft that over extra cover for a one bounce four, the first boundary for CSK

missed run-out, slower one bowled short on leg stump, Raina punched it to midwicket, Kohli collected and aimed at the striker's end, missed, Arun Karthik collected and took down the bails but Raina was in, needed a direct hit, Raina slipped while being sent back there
angling towards middle and leg, flicks it behind square for a single
short and it doesn't cost much, Badrinath went for the pull, got an inside edge to the keeper on the bounce

Christian bowls a no-ball, freehit coming, guides that one into the off side, dot ball, harsh call from Asad Rauf who called that a no-ball, Christian had not overstepped, a part of his foot was behind the line at the time of landing

Hussey holes out, big one, short and Hussey went after that one, swivelled and pulled it well but straight into the hands of deep square leg, no boundaries in the innings so far and the pressure was building on the Chennai batsmen, the openers are gone
slower offcutter, Hussey may have got an edge on that one as he tried to force it through off, didn't carry to the keeper
shortish on the off, gets back and punches it towards mid-on from the crease
short of a good length, gets on the back foot and plays it on the pitch, thinks of a single but it's not there
sliding on the pads again, turns it through square leg into the deep for a couple more runs
on leg stump, tries to shuffle across to play it fine, they get a couple of leg-byes as it clips the pads
sharp bouncer from Rampaul, banged it short on middle and Raina managed to glove that down, though he took his eyes off that one
slower one bowled full outside off, steers that behind point towards third man for a single
appeal from Rampaul, short of a length, Hussey tries to open the face there, misses, Rampaul goes up again but it's turned down this time
Raina moves a little across to turn it away towards fine leg for a single
appeal for lbw but that would have missed leg, swinging in, lands on leg and would have gone down, replays show it pitched outside leg in fact, tried to flick it and missed

big shout and it's given, short of a good length and Vijay poked at that one, the keeper and bowler went up immediately, Rauf took a while to give that out, Vijay shook his head as he went past Hussey, not sure if that's conclusive, Chennai have lost one early
back of a length on the off, pushed towards cover from the crease
short and slightly wide, chops that in the direction of short extra cover for a single
slightly short outside off, guides that towards point from the crease
bowled in the channel again, not a lot of width there, shoulders arms to that one as well as it moved away
in the channel outside off stump, leaves that one to the keeper, moved away a bit
swinging in towards middle, clipped through square leg from the crease for a single
slightly short on the off, gets on the back foot and knocks it towards cover from the crease
short of a good length, rocks on the back foot and pushes it back to the bowler
back of a length, gets on the back foot and taps that behind point for a single
back of a length on the off, pushes it towards cover from the crease, good bounce
back of a length outside off and he leaves that alone, called a wide, didn't seem like it was that wide
pushed it on a length outside off and Vijay lets that one go through
turns that towards fine leg, pushed him back there with a short of a good length ball, a single straightaway
